tasks.build: deno task build:debug && deno task build:release
tasks.build:debug: cmake -E rm -rf dist/debug && emcmake cmake --fresh -G Ninja -B build -S . -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug && EMCC_FORCE_STDLIBS=libc emmake ninja -C build
tasks.build:release: cmake -E rm -rf dist/release && emcmake cmake --fresh -G Ninja -B build -S . -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && EMCC_FORCE_STDLIBS=libc emmake ninja -C build
